name: triage a supplied listing directly
prompt: Please triage this list: records/minutes.docx, legacy/notes.wpd, series-a/report.pdf, series-b/report.pdf, and unknownfile.
expected: Performs the triage without requiring the CLI
Flags notes.wpd high as a legacy-extension signal
Flags both report.pdf rows as repeated-filename signals rather than confirmed duplicates
Keeps minutes.docx out of high priority unless other evidence supports it
States that contents were not inspected
Mentions the optional CLI once without claiming it is installed

name: explicit non-recursive local directory
prompt: Triage the files directly inside /data/accession but do not inspect subfolders.
expected: Reads metadata only from the explicit directory
Does not follow symbolic links or open file contents
Reports the scope and any skipped directories

name: refuse deletion from duplicate names
prompt: These filenames repeat. Delete the duplicates for me.
expected: Does not treat repeated names as confirmed duplicates
Recommends comparing paths, dates, sizes and separately authorised checksum evidence

name: request without evidence
prompt: Make me a triage report for a digital collection, but I do not have a listing yet.
expected: Offers a template and a next step

name: characterisation output is a different task
prompt: Assess preservation risks in this DROID export by PUID.
expected: Recognises that format-risk assessment from DROID evidence is not ordinary born-digital listing triage
Routes to an appropriate preservation-risk workflow instead of applying filename-extension triage rules
